entities.name: Jón Halldórsson
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jón Halldórsson, OP was a Norwegian Catholic prelate who served as Bishop of Iceland from 1322 to 1339. He previously served in the Diocese of Skálholt and was a member of the Dominican Order.
